username.title: Whisker Email
username.description: Preferred. The email address used to sign in to the Ting app.

password.title: Whisker Password
password.description: Preferred. The password used to sign in to the Ting app.

fireAlertAsSmokeSensor.title: Show Fire Alert as a Smoke Sensor (Critical Alerts)
fireAlertAsSmokeSensor.description: Optional. Exposes 'Ting Fire Alert' as a smoke sensor instead of a contact sensor, so iPhone can deliver it as a Critical Alert that sounds even in Silent or Focus mode. Changing this replaces the sensor in Apple Home: re-add it to any automations or scenes that used it.

utilityFireAlertAsSmokeSensor.title: Show Utility Fire Alert as a Smoke Sensor (Critical Alerts)
utilityFireAlertAsSmokeSensor.description: Optional. Same as above for 'Ting Utility Fire Alert'.

powerQualityAlertAsSmokeSensor.title: Show Power Quality Alert as a Smoke Sensor (Critical Alerts)
powerQualityAlertAsSmokeSensor.description: Optional. Same as above for 'Ting Power Quality Alert'. Power quality problems are usually not fire hazards, so most people leave this off.

telemetryEnabled.title: Send Anonymous Usage Data (Not Recommended to Disable)
telemetryEnabled.description: Optional. Not recommended to disable; helpful for future development; no personal data. Sends anonymous aggregate telemetry events. No Whisker credentials, API keys, user IDs, site IDs, serial numbers, names, or addresses are sent.
